stories.headline: Pakistan mediates US-Iran peace talks in Islamabad as negotiations end without agreement
stories.summary: Pakistan hosted direct talks between US Vice President JD Vance and Iranian officials in Islamabad, with Field Marshal Asim Munir and PM Shehbaz Sharif playing key mediation roles. After 21 hours of negotiations, talks concluded without a breakthrough, though Pakistan vowed to continue facilitating dialogue. The talks drew global attention to Pakistan's diplomatic role.

stories.headline: Pakistan deploys fighter jets and troops to Saudi Arabia under mutual defense pact
stories.summary: Pakistan deployed fighter jets and military personnel to Saudi Arabia's King Abdulaziz Air Base under a strategic defense agreement signed last year. The deployment comes as Pakistan simultaneously hosts US-Iran peace talks, highlighting the country's complex regional relationships and security commitments.

stories.headline: Imran Khan's health deteriorates in prison as legal battles and protests continue
stories.summary: PTI reports that imprisoned former PM Imran Khan's vision has dropped to 15% due to CRVO, demanding immediate medical care and transfer to Shifa Hospital. Meanwhile, his sisters and PTI leaders faced anti-terrorism charges after protests outside Adiala Jail, and the Islamabad High Court facilitated meetings with his lawyers.

stories.headline: Delhi Police bust ISI-backed espionage network, arrest 11 operatives across India
stories.summary: Delhi Police Special Cell dismantled a Pakistan ISI-backed spy network, arresting 11 people who allegedly installed solar-powered CCTV cameras near military installations to livestream footage to Pakistan handlers. The operation exposed surveillance activities across Delhi, Punjab, and other states.

stories.headline: Bilawal Bhutto warns of dire consequences if US-Iran talks fail, calls for sustained diplomacy
stories.summary: PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari warned that the world has no 'Plan B' if US-Iran negotiations fail, urging all stakeholders to prioritize diplomacy. He described the Islamabad talks as a 'phenomenal breakthrough' and emphasized Pakistan's role in averting wider regional conflict.

stories.summary: President Asif Ali Zardari congratulated newly elected presidents of Iraq, Vietnam and Vietnam on their elections, while Sindh CM reviewed MoUs signed during Zardari's recent visit to China to accelerate Pakistan-China cooperation projects including firefighting equipment deals.

stories.headline: Punjab Assembly resolution seeks Nobel Peace Prize nominations for Pakistani leaders
stories.summary: A PML-N lawmaker submitted a resolution in Punjab Assembly nominating PM Shehbaz Sharif, Field Marshal Asim Munir, and Deputy PM Ishaq Dar for the Nobel Peace Prize, citing their role in brokering the US-Iran ceasefire and demonstrating effective diplomacy amid regional tensions.

stories.headline: Pakistan Navy rescues 18 crew members in Arabian Sea maritime operation
stories.summary: Pakistan Navy ship PNS Hunain conducted a search and rescue operation in the North Arabian Sea, evacuating 18 crew members including foreign nationals from merchant vessel Gold Autumn after receiving a distress call. The operation took place 370km off Pakistan's coast.
